name: Long Young Electronic (Kunshan) Co., Ltd.
summary: Long Young Electronic (Kunshan) Co., Ltd. engages in the design and development, manufacture, and sale of electromagnetic shielding materials in China. It offers conductive cloth, conductive cloth tape, shielding insulating composite tape, microwave absorbing materials, conductive cloth foam, omnidirectional conductive sponge, and SMT conductive foam; thermal gap pad, anisotropic thermal pad, thermal insulator, thermally conductive gel, phase change materials, and thermal grease; insulation and protection products; sealing and gasketing, EV solution, and copper foils.
